name: instructional-design-toolkit
description: Guided instructional design toolkit for cmi5-compliant course and 1-on-1 session plan creation.

plugins.name: instructional-design-toolkit
plugins.description: Guided instructional design: 34 commands, 21 skills and 20 agents covering course and path design, 1-on-1 session plans (coach/mentor/tutor), the content-authoring pipeline (lessons, modules, text classes, challenges, quizzes, video scripts), slides, interactive workbooks, translation, and PIBER narrative architecture. cmi5-ready JSON, Markdown dense syllabus export, interactive HTML visualization with Bloom's + ship milestones, Marp deck per lesson, Tally/Typeform feedback embeds, CSV adapters for xAPI + feedback (Ralph/SCORM Cloud/Learning Locker/Tally API/Typeform API stubs for v2), iteration commands with semantic versioning. Imports personas from SRD, business-model-toolkit, and ux-research-toolkit maps. Based on SAM (Allen), Builder's Bloom's (Chimera Academy), Ship-First Design, Kirkpatrick L1-L4, Atomic Habits (Clear), Irby 2018 coach/mentor/tutor distinction.
